scenes.text: Boston is a point to point marathon, from Hopkinton into the city.
It starts on Main Street in Hopkinton, a small town west of Boston.
Near halfway, runners pass the Wellesley College scream tunnel.
At mile sixteen the Newton hills begin. Four climbs in five miles.
The last one, Heartbreak Hill, tops out near Boston College.
The Citgo sign in Kenmore Square means about one mile to go.
Right on Hereford, left on Boylston, and the finish line.
